title: Hawaii crypto ATM ban to take effect on Oct. 1
summary: Hawaii will join Minnesota, Tennessee and Indiana in becoming the fourth US state to completely ban the use of cryptocurrency ATMs and kiosks in response to scams.

title: Goldman Sachs to acquire ETF manager NEOS in $2.25B deal
summary: The deal would add NEOS’ $30 billion ETF business, including Bitcoin- and Ether-linked income funds, to Goldman Sachs Asset Management.

title: Rio Tinto Aluminum Smelter Receives $1.8 Billion Bailout
summary: The owners of Australia’s biggest aluminum smelter, including Rio Tinto Group, secured a government bailout of A$2.5 billion ($1.8 billion) to keep the plant operating as they grapple with high energy costs.

title: Atlas Merchant Invests in Edge Focus
summary: Bob Diamond, CEO of Atlas Merchant Capital & Elliott Lorenz, Co-Founder & CEO of Edge Focus discuss the new minority investment. They also discussed the role of private credit in consumer debt.   (Source: Bloomberg)
